items.q: Because I worked with Frank Sinatra making records in 1948, I believe

ctx.x: Buddy (inaudible) Sinatra, but he wasn't a member.
Frank Sinatra. I doubt that Buddy had ever met Frank Sinatra at that time.
He said that Frank Sinatra was one of the entertainers who supported the merge.
